question: What was the root cause of INC-2025-008?
contexts: - [2025-08-01] incident-review/INC-2025-017: Review of INC-2025-017 (the auth gateway, 2025-07-27). The root cause was an expired intermediate certificate. - [2025-02-11] incident-review/INC-2025-004: Review of INC-2025-004 (the notifier, 2025-02-06). The root cause was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. - [2025-10-16] incident-review/INC-2025-023: Review of INC-2025-023 (search-indexer, 2025-10-13). The root cause was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. We decided that reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.

- [2026-01-22] incident-review/INC-2026-003: Incident review INC-2026-003. Webhooks delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. Root cause: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. Decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.

- [2025-04-28] incident-review/INC-2025-011: INC-2025-011 review. What happened: the ledger service saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-26. Why: an index missing after the schema migration. Follow-up decision: ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.

- [2026-05-08] incident-review/INC-2026-009: INC-2026-009 review. What happened: scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. Why: two leaders elected during a network partition.
